dataset: "ExamCheating _MultiV video-based Dataset" (ExamCheat-MultiV) by rimmajeed, Kaggle, https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rimmajeed/examcheating-multiv-video-based-dataset, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Changes: pose keypoints and derived features were extracted with YOLOv8n-pose; such derived data are adaptations and, if shared, must be shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

b1.note: positive = whole clip of a class whose behaviour involves looking down at an object; not every frame of such a clip is head-down (label noise)

b2.note: no glasses-touch positives in ExamCheat-MultiV: firing rates are a false-alarm baseline only

gaps.definition: gap = time between two consecutive frames with a valid head_drop that are separated by >= 1 frame without it (nose or a shoulder below kpt_conf, or no subject)
